title: rustfmt drift on master 59b2fd4: `cargo fmt -- --check` fails in 19 test files
outcome:
`cargo fmt -- --check` on master 59b2fd4 reports formatting differences in 19 files, all under src/tests/:
acceptance_evaluation.rs, agent_commands.rs, delegation_followup_admission.rs, delegation_wait.rs, engram_bind_backoff_retry.rs, engram_first_extraction.rs, engram_lost_shell_overlap.rs, home_fixture.rs, http_routes.rs, kimi.rs, kimi_approvals.rs, kimi_read_only.rs, mod.rs, opencode_approvals.rs, phase_sync.rs, review_freeze.rs, test_run_cards.rs, test_run_waits.rs, test_runs.rs.
The gate does not run a formatting check, so the drift accumulates unseen. Fix: a pure formatting commit of those files with `cargo fmt`, with no other changes, gated like any change. Optionally, decide whether the gate should run `cargo fmt -- --check`.
acceptance: `cargo fmt -- --check` passes on the landed tree.
The fix commit changes formatting only; its diff ignoring whitespace (`git diff -w`) contains no code change beyond line wrapping.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 body comparison b80d766c; applied by Termal::Fable2): duplicate rustfmt-drift item, covered by w-a490c271ed2e. The survivor's holder must also cover this item's three extra file names, listed in note b80d766c.
